ios.desc:
Find all our features:
Route calculation (electric or classic, car, motorcycle, bicycle, on foot), points of interest with selections from the MICHELIN Guides for restaurants, hotels, and tourist sites as well as our maps enriched with Michelin selections and various services like gas stations with prices, parking and electric charging stations. Not to mention GPS navigation and traffic information.

Route planning with new options and trip cost:
- Calculate your route with a gasoline or electric vehicle and get the average cost of your trip.
- Discover our points of interest along your route including MICHELIN selections: restaurants, hotels, and tourist sites.
- Make the cost of your trip more precise by using various available options such as vehicle type, specifying the exact fuel price, avoiding tolls.
- Organize your road trips by adding up to 15 stops to your itinerary.

Maps:
- Michelin maps lightened or historical, and 3D map in GPS navigation mode.
- Map enriched with addresses from various MICHELIN selections - restaurants, hotels, tourist sites.
- Possibility to find the nearest gas station or electric charging stations around you, ideal in the preparation phase of your electric car trip.

Traffic information:
Present on the map in real-time, it allows you to identify potential traffic jams and the main reasons for slowdowns - roadworks, accidents, closed roads.

GPS Navigation:
- Combustion engine car and electric car GPS navigation system.
- Simple and precise voice guidance.
- Guidance based on Michelin map.

ViaMichelin account:
Create your account to enter your vehicle information and get a more precise calculation of the journey cost during your travels.
Regularly find new features to enrich your road experience with ViaMichelin.

Download the app now!
